normalization_plan.reason: Amount is only meaningful as the caller-supplied value consumed by the transfer/_transfer flow.
Recipient is a transient argument whose effect is fully captured by the transfer function.
from is an internal parameter of _transfer used for branching on sender identity.
to is an internal parameter of _transfer used for pair/cooldown checks.
tokenAmount exists only to feed the router swap performed by swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary derived inside _transfer for the auto-swap branch.
onoff is the single boolean argument stored by the owner-only setter.
